name: @orbitalfee/mcfo-sdk
description: Orbital Fee fee selection for Ethereum transactions: a typed client for the Orbital Fee API plus an ethers/viem submission helper. Never handles private keys.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/client.test.js test/send.test.js test/contract.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='dist/**' --test-coverage-lines=95 --test-coverage-branches=90 --test-coverage-functions=95 test/client.test.js test/send.test.js test/contract.test.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build && MCFO_LIVE=1 node --test test/live.test.js
